vtxrisograph, A man-shaped white chalk outline of a homicide crime scene. It's drawn on the sidewalk with its limbs sprawled out in an asyemetric pose. Outside of its borders we see a street running through a grey and grimy nighttime city scene. The world is rendered in tiny dots of white, black, and colrful spot inks on gray paper that shows organic risograph grain. 

Inside of the chalk outline there are no details of who the man was, like fingers, shoes or hair; there's only the black void of space, dotted lightly by stars and stellar imagery.  The image is heartwrenching, and the loss of life is palpable in the way the whole image comes apart into tiny atomized halftones.

This image contains no linework or detail. It is merely clouds of clean halftones dots at various densities to paint the image. The border of the image is torn rough grey paper where the ink doesn't quite reach the edges, framing the piece.
